note: Unity (x, y, z) = Blender (-x, z, -y); the front of each piece faces Unity +Z as built. The lived-in pass (findings 12 Oct, section 8), built by Tools/Blender/cafe_livedin.py; textures by cafe_livedin_textures.py into Assets/Art/Textures/Cafe/LI_*.png. collider: the piece's solid in its own Unity frame ({centre, size}, cafe_seating.json's form), null for none. A y of 0 in a place line means the floor's top: find it by a ray down, as CafeFurnishing.Mat does (TopAt); where the bench and drink mats lie it is 0.0165, and a rug set at y 0 there would sit under the floor. The kid's drawing's words are PLACEHOLDER COPY (THANK YOU ACE!, LILY 6).

pieces.name: LI_Rug_Corner
pieces.what: flatweave rug 1.60 x 1.10, 10 mm, oat with rust and charcoal stripes near the ends (texture)
pieces.place: the reading corner, where people sit softly: under a low table between two soft seats, never under chairs that slide. The café has no corner like that since the redesign; a free one: the front-west corner beside the fiddle-leaf fig, about (-5.5, 0, 2.0), long side along x (clear of the fig at (-6.85, 0, 0.75) and the banquette's south end at z 3.62). On the floor, no turn needed

label.uv: 0..1 over the top, u along the rug's length (x), v across it, as seen from above with the front at the bottom; the chamfers take the picture's outer 4 mm (the hems), the sides and the bottom one hem texel

pieces.name: LI_Rug_Entry
pieces.what: plain coir entry mat 1.20 x 0.70 x 0.017 on a black PVC back (texture)
pieces.place: inside the door. CK_EntryMosaic covers z 0.20-1.40 from the threshold, so the mat lies on the door's inner side past it, its near edge on the mosaic's inner edge: about (0, 0, 1.78), long side along x. If the mosaic should stay the only entry floor, leave this one out (Environment's call)

label.uv: 0..1 over the top as seen from above (u along x, v along y), the chamfer the picture's cut edge; the sides one coir texel; the PVC backing is CF_Black

label.uv: 0..1 over the top and the bevelled ramp as seen from above (the ramp is the picture's outer 25 mm); the 1.5 mm lip one ramp texel

pieces.name: LI_CondimentStation

pieces.place: on the front counter's stone top at the pickup end, between the intake shelf (its last tray ends at x 1.74) and the pastry case (x 3.2), about (2.85, 1.095, 13.50), turned 180 degrees so its front faces the customers (the water station's way)

pieces.name: LI_BinStation
pieces.what: San Francisco's three-stream station 0.956 x 0.430 x 0.851: RECYCLING, COMPOST, LANDFILL (labels textured)
pieces.place: inside, near the door where leaving guests pass, its back to a wall: e.g. against the front wall's inner face west of the door beside the olive tree, about (-2.75, 0, 0.24) with no turn (it faces the room), or on the west wall's free stretch (z 1.3-3.5) at about (-7.17, 0, 2.4) turned 90 degrees. It stands 7 cm above the 0.78 sill: fine in front of a window

label.uv: three plates share the texture: the left plate (RECYCLING) maps to the left third, COMPOST the middle, LANDFILL the right (columns round(k*1024/3)..round((k+1)*1024/3), inset 3 px); u to the reader's right, v up, on each plate's front; its edges one border texel of its own third

pieces.name: LI_StreetBin

pieces.place: outside on the pavement near the café's door, by the kerb, the mouth toward the pavement (no turn: it faces +z, turn it 180 degrees to face the café); clear of the patio, the bench and the A-frame at (3.48, 0, -2.32)

LI_RugCorner.why: NEW, textured: the flatweave's top (oat, rust, charcoal; no existing rug material is in the root folder the kit importer searches, and the house kit's HK_Rug_* are flat colours)

LI_CoirMat.why: NEW, textured: coir bristles (HK_Coir is a flat colour in a sub-folder the importer does not search)

LI_RubberMat.why: NEW, textured: black rubber and its drainage holes, smoothness as the bench and drink mats' "Mat - rubber" (0.22), which lives in Assets/Art/CafeFurnishing and cannot be mapped by name

LI_BinLabels.why: NEW, textured: the three stream labels, vinyl stickers (satin)

LI_KidsDrawing.why: NEW, textured: printer paper and wax crayon

LI_RecycleBlue.why: NEW: the recycling stream's blue (San Francisco's blue cart), moulded plastic

LI_CompostGreen.why: NEW: the compost stream's green, a grass green kept well apart from Ace's teal #2E7D5B

LI_StreetGreen.why: NEW: the city litter can's dark green powder coat (darker and greyer than Ace's green)

LI_CupPaper.why: NEW: the café's paper cup, the exact colour the game draws it in (DrinkLiquidVisual.PaperColour 0.91, 0.85, 0.70, "Warm ivory paper", smoothness 0.08); also the birch stirrers

LI_Screen.why: NEW, textured: the laptop's screen, on: a dark title bar over a light page (24 Oct 2026, art audit a50: the flat dark-glass panel at smoothness 0.85 mirrored the room as a pale blue slab and read as a dead screen; the picture is cafe_art_fix_textures.py's)

LI_Chrome.why: NEW (24 Oct 2026, art audit a48): the napkin holder's polished body, a bright glossy steel (metallic 0, the house rule), so it reads as the diner chrome it is and not a grey box
